findings.statement: Entity type is Individual (sole proprietor), so no California Secretary of State registration is expected; a California DBA would be filed at San Diego County level and was not locatable. The required California Bureau of Automotive Repair (BAR) Automotive Repair Dealer registration could not be checked: the DCA licence lookup loads as a JavaScript form with no submittable query endpoint reachable by automation, so no real register search could be completed. Treated as registry blocked, not as a missing licence.
findings.establishes: No entity registration is expected for a sole proprietor; the BAR auto repair dealer register could not be searched because the DCA lookup blocks automation.

findings.statement: No independent listing or social page for "ManiTech" mobile automotive repair was found in Escondido or North San Diego County. Searches across general web, Google, Yelp, Facebook, Instagram and Thumbtack indexed results and local mobile-mechanic directories returned only unrelated Escondido shops and aggregator pages. Mobile auto repair is a service business that need not have a fixed-premises footprint, so absence of a listing is not scored as a contradiction.
findings.establishes: No observable independent presence placing the business in Escondido; not adverse for this business type.

There is no evidence of an independent presence of one year or more, and equally no adverse history.

San Diego County fictitious business name (DBA) filing for the trading name, or an explanation of why the trading name differs from the descriptor.
Any customer-facing presence: Google Business Profile, Yelp, Facebook, Instagram, Nextdoor or Thumbtack listing, a website, or dated invoices showing mobile repair jobs in the Escondido area.

summary: ManiTech mobile automotive repair has no observable public footprint at all: no website, no Google, Yelp, Facebook, Instagram or Thumbtack listing, no directory entry, no reviews and no news or complaint records anywhere in Escondido or North San Diego County. Nothing adverse was found either, and because mobile auto repair legitimately operates without fixed premises and the entity is an Individual for which no Secretary of State registration is expected, every dimension scores 0 - a clean but entirely unevidenced file rather than a positively verified one. The one open discrepancy is that the statement descriptor is a personal name appearing in neither the business name nor the email handle, so it must be reconciled against the representative on file; the representative feed was unavailable this run. The California BAR Automotive Repair Dealer register, which mobile auto repair in California does require, could not be searched because the DCA lookup blocks automation, so a licensed-status check remains the first manual follow-up.
